title: TypeScript: Unverified JWT Decode Allows Admin Signature Forgery
pr_title: feat(auth): Express middleware for Bearer token validation
summary: AI generated Express authentication middleware decodes JWT payload without validating cryptographic HMAC signature or token expiration.
impact: Authentication Bypass & Privilege Escalation (CWE-347): Any unauthenticated attacker can forge a Bearer token with { role: 'admin' } and gain full access to private tenant APIs.
root_cause: Handler uses decodeJwt(token) instead of cryptographic verifyJwt(token, secret) signature verification.
proposed_fix_summary: Enforce HMAC-SHA256 signature verification and token expiration validation.
unresolved_risks: Token revocation / blacklist cache lookup is not implemented.
Refresh token rotation policy must be audited across mobile and web clients.
Clock skew tolerance between auth server and API gateway is not specified.
